# PyYAML 6.0.3

Pure-Python source files copied unmodified from the installed PyYAML 6.0.3 distribution.
Upstream: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml
License: MIT, reproduced in yaml/LICENSE.

The optional compiled extension and cyaml.py are intentionally excluded, so this
dependency works without a platform-specific binary or a host PyYAML installation.
DeckSmith uses safe_load only. Keep the license and this notice when redistributing.
